story_summary: The relay network destabilized after an unsolved Vigenère decryption; yesterday's riddle remained unanswered, heightening the threat of hostile signals.
last_challenge: Write a program that reads a single line of uppercase letters, converts each to its alphabetical position, sums them, takes the sum modulo 97, and outputs the result as a two-character lowercase hexadecimal string (padded with a leading zero if needed).
